summary: Feed s165_triple is degraded with 3 faults: 85.8% encrypted traffic exceeds IDS 60% tolerance, 2.2% jumbo frames (up to 8058B) dropped by 1518B IDS port, and 6.6% TCP data missing due to packet broker slicing. IDS is blind to most payloads and missing frames/payload for inspection.

findings.root_cause: 86% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) and forwarded as-is. Packet broker has no SSL visibility/decryption policy, so IDS receives ciphertext it cannot inspect. Exceeds IDS tolerance of 60%.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full payload for signature matching but cannot inspect encrypted payloads - ~86% of traffic is opaque, causing massive blind spot and missed exploit/C2 detection, high false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: IDS needs cleartext payload; decrypt at packet broker with key sharing / SSL visibility appliance or selectively forward only decryptable traffic to restore inspection capability.

findings.root_cause: Upstream network is sending jumbo frames up to 8058 bytes but IDS 1Gbps port max_frame_bytes is 1518. Packet broker is not normalizing MTU/slicing, so NIC drops oversize frames before IDS sees them. 60/2713 frames (2.2%) affected.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS NIC drops 2.2% of frames as oversize - those flows are never analyzed, creating detection gaps for attacks carried in large frames and breaking flow reassembly.

recommended_fix.why: Tool port cannot receive frames >1518; either enable 9000B jumbo support on IDS NIC or configure packet broker to normalize/slice to 1518B so frames are not silently dropped.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker has payload slicing enabled (detail notes 'feed is sliced'). Slicing truncates packets after headers, causing TCP sequence gaps - 169/2575 TCP packets (6.6%) show missing data by IP length sequence analysis.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs_full_payload=true but receives truncated flows - TCP reassembly fails, signatures requiring full payload/stream never fire, and IDS reports incomplete sessions, severely degrading detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: IDS requires full payload for detection; disable slicing/truncation on this broker feed to deliver complete packets and eliminate sequence gaps.
